title: Raikiri
body:
Syntax: perform raikiri <target>

Description: An opening-only Lightning strike against an unhurt target, dealing 50% more damage when it connects. An opening attack with 50% extra damage; cannot be used mid-fight or against a wounded target. Requires Lightning chakra nature. Base damage: 689-809. Unlocks at level 60. Costs 58 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 10 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
